captures.description: THE IDENTIFIER, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'ORCID (Open Researcher and Contributor ID) is a free, 16-digit persistent digital identifier that uniquely identifies scholars, researchers, and contributors.' What ORCID Does (name ambiguity; research output linked 'into a single portable profile'; syncing with publishers and 'funding agencies (such as the NIH)'); Key Details (free; 'Rendered as a URL, such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`'; privacy control); two follow-up offers on registering and on NIH eRA Commons. Eight cards: ORCID, Wikipedia, Springer Nature, NIH, Stanford guides, two YouTube videos, Directive Publications.

atoms.evidence: ORCID (Open Researcher and Contributor ID) is a free, 16-digit persistent digital identifier
ORCID is a non-profit organisation providing researchers with a unique digital identifier.
is a free, 16-digit persistent digital identifier that uniquely identifies scholars, researchers, and contributors.
Resolves Name Ambiguity: It stops confusion between researchers who share identical or similar names, or when names change over time.
Cost: Free for all researchers to register and use.
Format: Rendered as a URL, such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.
